persona: MIS executive who built Power Apps for a factory, moving to a developer role
resumeText:
Pooja Mehta | Ahmedabad | pooja.mehta@example.com

EXPERIENCE
MIS Executive, Sabarmati Textiles Ltd, Ahmedabad (2023 - present)
- Built a canvas app in Power Apps for 40 field staff to log daily dye-house output.
- Created Power Automate flows that email the plant head when a batch fails quality checks.
- Store app data in SharePoint lists and manage list permissions for each plant.
- Meet plant managers to collect their reporting needs and write them up as a one-page brief.
- Build Power BI dashboards on top of the SharePoint data.
- Present monthly production numbers to the leadership team.

EDUCATION
BCom, Gujarat University, 2023

SKILLS
Excel, VBA, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SharePoint, Dataverse
